decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to control the game by disrupting your opponent's plays with counterspells, discard spells, and board wipes. You aim to outvalue your opponent by generating card advantage through card draw and graveyard recursion. The inclusion of powerful threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Murktide Regent helps you close out the game once you've stabilized the board. Overall, the deck focuses on dominating the game through resource management and strategic decision making.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional damage and control. The inclusion of cards like Static Prison and Ranger-Captain of Eos help disrupt opponents' strategies while maintaining a fast pace. Showdown of the Skalds provides additional card advantage and Ocelot Pride offers a strong creature base. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and flickering effects to constantly disrupt the opponent's strategy. Using cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck aims to repeatedly remove threats and gain incremental advantage. The key is to create a tempo advantage by blinking important creatures at the right time, while also disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. This strategy allows the deck to control the battlefield and apply pressure constantly, overwhelming the opponent with its aggressive plays and disruptive abilities.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones, and then bring them back into play using cards like Persist and Unearth. Thoughtseize and Thought Scour help with card selection and filling the graveyard, while Psychic Frog provides additional card advantage. The deck also includes some control elements like Spell Pierce and Fatal Push to help protect your combo pieces. Overall, the deck focuses on utilizing graveyard recursion to overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and board control through a combination of creatures with abilities and spells that can deal damage quickly to the opponent. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature presence and burn spells, while also utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The deck also includes cards that provide incremental advantage and disruption, such as Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply pressure early and maintain control of the battlefield to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts and utilizing cards to draw more cards while maintaining board presence and disrupting the opponent's strategy. By combining aggressive creatures like Cori-Steel Cutter with powerful artifacts and card draw like Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtcast, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a high tempo playstyle. Emry, Lurker of the Loch serves as a versatile recursion engine, while cards like Metallic Rebuke and Galvanic Blast provide disruption and removal options. Additionally, Urza's Saga and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student add consistency and late-game power to the deck.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while controlling the board through counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize, Counterspell, and Fatal Push to maintain control, while also utilizing cards like Murktide Regent and Tamiyo to generate card advantage and threats on the board. The deck aims to control the game tempo and resources, gradually wearing down the opponent's resources until it can establish its own win condition and secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through land ramp and manipulation with cards like Elvish Reclaimer and Khalni Heart Expedition, while aiming to assemble the combo of Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Scapeshift to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent's life total in one turn. The deck also includes utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Flagstones of Trokair for added versatility. The goal is to stall the game until the combo can be executed for a win.

The deck revolves around efficiently ramping up mana and utilizing lands to pull off powerful combos, ultimately aiming to use Primeval Titan to search for lands like Gruul Turf, Urza's Saga, and Lotus Field to generate explosive amounts of mana, then utilize cards like Scapeshift and Aftermath Analyst to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and game-winning plays. The deck's synergy with Amulet of Vigor allows for even faster and more impactful combos, making it a force to be reckoned with in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells. Using cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to deal damage quickly, while also utilizing Mutagenic Growth to pump up their creatures. The deck includes a variety of cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to control the board and finish off opponents. Slickshot Show-Off provides additional damage potential, while Expressive Iteration and Preordain help to filter through the deck and find key cards. The mana base is designed for consistency and speed, with a focus on red and blue sources.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to generate a lethal combo, while also using resources like Ancient Stirrings and Kozilek's Command to control the board. It includes powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Thought-Knot Seer to disrupt opponent's plans. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to search for key artifacts like Blade of the Bloodchief and Soul-Guide Lantern. With the ability to ramp up quickly and overwhelm opponents with its combo potential, this deck is built to be a versatile and dangerous force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on utilizing the interactions between Broodscale Bloodchief, Walking Ballista, and Writhing Chrysalis to create a powerful combo that generates massive amounts of value and control on the battlefield. The deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces using cards like Urza's Saga and Traverse the Ulvenwald, while also providing disruption and protection with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Soul-Guide Lantern. With a mix of creatures, artifacts, and spells, this deck can adapt to various situations and strategies, ultimately overwhelming opponents with its synergies and combos.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption and card advantage to control the game. It utilizes a variety of counterspells and removal spells to handle opponent's threats while also using card draw and filtering to maintain resources. The deck also includes alternative win conditions in the form of powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog to close out the game. By controlling the board and out-valuing opponents, this deck aims to grind out wins through a combination of removal, countermagic, and card advantage.

This deck aims to assemble the UrzaTron land combo to generate large amounts of colorless mana quickly. By ramping up mana, the deck can cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Sire of Seven Deaths, as well as use Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opponent's strategies and search for key artifacts. Control elements like Ugin, the Eye of Storms and Chalice of the Void help disrupt opponent's plans, while cards like Devourer of Destiny and Anticausal Vestige provide additional removal and utility. The deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with big threats and powerful spells.

The deck focuses on using various cycling creatures and spells to fill the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back into play simultaneously. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by cycling cards, while setting up a massive board presence with powerful creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves. The deck prioritizes controlling the board and overwhelming the opponent with a large number of creatures all at once. The goal is to quickly close out the game by overwhelming the opponent with a flurry of powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's strategy through a combination of efficient counterspells, hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures with disruptive abilities. It aims to control the game by constantly disrupting the opponent's plans while generating card advantage and tempo through card draw and resource denial. With a mix of disruption, removal, and powerful creatures, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a long and grindy game, ultimately establishing control over the game and securing victory through incremental advantages.
